title: Capit Helmet Dryer Pro
features: Rapidly dries motorcycle helmets after washing or rain exposure
Prevents mold and mildew growth inside helmet liners
Includes adjustable stand for optimal airflow circulation
description:
Built to protect your helmet investment between epic journeys, the Capit Helmet Dryer Pro from Capit delivers comprehensive hygiene, drying, and surface protection. Built with Indoor / Paddock Workshop Safe (CE / UL Certified Thermal Cutoff), it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Direct wipe application or plug-and-play operation).

The Capit Helmet Dryer Pro from Capit is a must-have maintenance asset for riders who value helmet longevity. It keeps premium EPS liners hygienic, odor-free, and protected between track days and long-haul expeditions.
